insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Orianna is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Orianna in 29/56 games (52%): 7 picks (7-0) and 22 bans.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they stay closer to their core than most
insights.text: In 15 G3+ games, 21/75 picks (28%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 42%). Pool: 56 champs in G1s, 51 in G3+.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Xin Zhao? They go Skarner
insights.text: Xin Zhao is a G1 favorite (8/26 G1s, played by SkewMond). In the 19 later games where it was burned or banned, SkewMond went to Skarner (5/19) and Trundle (2/19).

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: They open bans on Orianna
insights.text: Orianna is their first ban in 16/56 games (29%). Expect it gone before your first pick.
